alignments.note: Purpose conjunction realized by the word introducing its English clause under rule 40.
Comparative adverb rendered by 'according as'; no kai answers it, so the whole expression stays with it, headed on 'as'.
Inflected perfect passive with its supplied subject and copula; head on the lexical verb.
Substantival article before a participle supplies the pronoun and nothing else under rule 32.
Participle keeps the relativizer as its helper; head on the verb word.
Greek is anarthrous, so the supplied 'the' is a rule 51 helper on the noun.
Third-person imperative rendered by the 'let him' frame; the auxiliary and pronoun are rule 7/9 helpers and the head is the lexical verb.
